notes: «هو ابن مسلمة» is an editor's gloss and is left out; «أبيه» is named only by relation

Needs ruling (rule 11, first-person narrative with implicit transmission): from «قال فتلطفت» on, the story is in the first person of Abd Allah b. Atik, who is named only inside the story; he is not added, and the chain ends at al-Bara as written
